task: binary classification of end-of-term academic risk (term grade < 80) from class-record components recorded before the term examination

dataset.source: Merged E-Class Record export, Looc National High School, 15 class records, SY 2022-2023 / 2023-2024 / 2025-2026

features_excluded.Term Exam Score / Percentage / Weighted: not known until the term examination is sat; it is part of the outcome the model is asked to anticipate
features_excluded.Initial Grade: the weighted sum that the target is derived from
features_excluded.Name: personal information; hashed to a learner key for grouping and never stored
features_excluded.Sex: excluded as a fairness liability, not for want of signal
features_excluded.Section / Subject / School Year: identifiers; the file is 95.6% Filipino and 86.8% Grade 8, so these would encode the cohort rather than the learner

protocol.splits: GroupShuffleSplit by learner, 10 splits, test fraction 0.3
protocol.threshold_selection: inner StratifiedGroupKFold on training learners, macro F1 subject to recall ≥ 0.8
protocol.significance: Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t-test with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment

limitations: The term grade is a weighted sum of the components used as features, so the task is substantially arithmetic. The arithmetic baseline in the comparison table is the honest point of reference, not a naive control.
No attendance data exists in this export, so attendance plays no part in the model.
86.8% of rows are Grade 8 and 95.6% are Filipino. Conclusions do not extend to other grade levels or subjects.
Performance is established at the point where Written Works and Performance Tasks are complete and the term examination is not. No claim is made about earlier points in the term.
